column7: REVIEW-3018: storage.ListSharesByUser / ListSharesByOwner cut a list off silently at maxUnboundedListRows, and three core readers handed such a list on unchecked: ListSharesByUser (gRPC/CLI, answered Internal), the shared-with-me secret listing (getSharedSecretsWithSharingInfo) and GetDashboardStats' share counts. A shortened share list hides shares from whoever reviews or revokes them. Each now refuses with ErrShareListOverCap (gRPC FailedPrecondition) or degrades the count, decided per fetch. Red on main. Siblings: TestSharedWithMeSecretListing_RefusesAFetchAtTheCap, TestGetDashboardStats_DegradesShareCountsAtTheCap (share_list_cap_siblings_test.go), server/grpc/services TestShareService_ListUserShares_OverCapIsFailedPrecondition, and the family guard internal/core/guards TestShareListFetchCallersRefuseAtTheCap.
